# HubSpot   [Skip link to HubSpot](https://developers.typeface.ai/docs/integrations-hubspot\#hubspot)

Connect Typeface with **HubSpot** to streamline email and audience workflows across both platforms.

The HubSpot integration supports Email and Customer Data Platform (CDP) use cases, allowing you to publish emails from Typeface to HubSpot and import audience segments into Typeface.

### What You Can Do with the HubSpot Connector   [Skip link to What You Can Do with the HubSpot Connector](https://developers.typeface.ai/docs/integrations-hubspot\#what-you-can-do-with-the-hubspot-connector)

| Integration | Description |
| --- | --- |
| HubSpot Email | Publish emails created in Typeface directly to HubSpot. |
| HubSpot CDP | Import audience segments from HubSpot into Typeface. |

## HubSpot Email   [Skip link to HubSpot Email](https://developers.typeface.ai/docs/integrations-hubspot\#hubspot-email)

- Publish emails created in Typeface directly to HubSpot.
- Create and preview emails in Typeface before publishing.
- Select a configured HubSpot connection for publishing.
- View the published email in HubSpot.

## HubSpot CDP   [Skip link to HubSpot CDP](https://developers.typeface.ai/docs/integrations-hubspot\#hubspot-cdp)

- Import audience segments from HubSpot into Typeface.
- Select the date from which audience data should be retrieved.
- Receive an email notification when the audience import is complete.
